init_process_group: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group with nccl backend for multi-machine training
all_gather_tensors: gather tensors from all processes across machines and concatenate them along dimension 0
all_reduce_tensors: reduce tensors across all processes with optional averaging by world size
all_gather_unaligned_data: gather arbitrary picklable data from all ranks using the gloo backend
all_gather_with_gradient: perform distributed all_gather on tensors while preserving gradient computation through autograd
